newsitem.title: USA: SyQuest says Iomega suit meritless.
newsitem.headline: SyQuest says Iomega suit meritless.

text.p: SyQuest Technology Inc said Tuesday it considers a patent lawsuit filed against it by Iomega Corp to be without merit.

"We believe this claim is without merit," President and Chief Executive Ed Harper said in a telephone interview with Reuters. "This represents, probably, an attempt by Iomega to move this battle from the marketplace to the courtroom."
Iomega has filed a complaint in U.S. District Court in Delaware, accusing SyQuest of infringing on its patents and trademarks.
In the complaint, Iomega contends that SyQuest infringed two Iomega patents: one covering its Read/Write Protection Scheme and the other covering the design of its Jaz cartridge.
((-- Lisa Marie Pane, New York Newsdesk 212-859-1713))
